title: Verify: Keyboard moves write the store focusedObjectId unit tests
summary: Unit tests for store writes on Tab, Shift+Tab and arrows
description: Add bootSceneKeyboardStore.test.ts reusing the Phaser, content, buildScene and moveFocus mocks from tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Shift+Tab and ArrowLeft call setFocusedObject with 'bookshelf'.

steps.action: Copy the vi.mock blocks and beforeEach setup from tests/bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts. Add tests: press('Tab') then expect useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId toBe 'bookshelf'; press('Tab', true) and press('ArrowLeft') spy on setFocusedObject via vi.spyOn(useGameStore.getState(), 'setFocusedObject') and expect calledWith 'bookshelf'; expect emit toHaveBeenCalledWith('focusChange', { id: 'bookshelf' }).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneKeyboardStore.test.ts
steps.expected: All tests in the file pass.
